extension.description: Right-click supported files in Explorer or editor tab to open them in VS Code's built-in Simple Browser. File extensions are user-configurable.
configuration.title: Open in Integrated Browser
configuration.autoAssociateAsDefaultByEx: Per-extension checkbox map. Each key is an extension (without leading dot). If checked (`true`), this extension appears in the context menu and is written to `workbench.editorAssociations` so files default-open with this extension. If unchecked (`false`), it still appears in the context menu but default-open is not forced. Example: `{ "html": true, "xml": false }`.
